name: 3S Vitals
author: Joakim
description: Compact vitals HUD: four stat gauges plus the current enemy and its health. Draws HP / Seid / Vig / Rad for a Viking character and HP / SP / GP1 / GP2 for every other guild, picking the set from whether the viking feed is live. Extracted from 3S Viking Status so the bars you glance at mid-fight live in their own small panel.
